questions.question: Dr. Mourad must train young dentists in HR management. What is the first piece of advice he should give them?
options: HR management is an administrative constraint
HR management is a lever for performance and retention
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'HR management is a lever for performance and retention that allows building a sustainable team.' Dr. Sidki: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Sidki must create a training center in dental HR management. What is the main objective?
options: Train dentists in human resources management
questions.explanation: Dr. Sidki explains: 'The main objective is to train dentists in human resources management and leadership.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will participate in this training.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad must evaluate a young dentist's HR performance. Which measure is most important?
options: Quality of team management and retention
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'The quality of team management and retention are the most important measures.' Dr. Sidki: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Sidki must manage an HR crisis: a conflict between two employees. What is the priority?
options: Listen to both parties and seek mediation
questions.explanation: Dr. Sidki explains: 'The priority is to listen to both parties and seek mediation to resolve the conflict.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will help you manage this crisis.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad must train interns in HR risk management. What is the fundamental principle?
options: HR risk management is a responsibility
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'HR risk management is a fundamental professional responsibility.' Dr. Sidki: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Sidki must create a guide to good HR practices. What is the main reference?
options: The Labor Code and collective agreement
questions.explanation: Dr. Sidki explains: 'Good practices must be based on the Labor Code and collective agreement.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will contribute to this guide.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad must train young dentists in team motivation. What is the key message?
options: Motivation is a lever for performance
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Motivation is a lever for performance and team retention.' Dr. Sidki: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Sidki must create a research program in dental HR management. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: Dr. Sidki explains: 'Research in HR management aims to improve team management practices.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will participate in the research.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad must manage a reference practice in HR management. What is the pillar of excellence?
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Excellence is based on the quality of team and management.' Dr. Sidki: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Sidki must evaluate the impact of HR management on practice performance. What is the role of HR management?
questions.explanation: Dr. Sidki explains: 'HR management is essential for the performance and sustainability of the practice.' Dr. Mourad: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad must train interns in HR innovation. What current trend is important?
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'HR innovation concerns digitalization, flexibility, and well-being at work.' Dr. Sidki: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Sidki must create an HR skills assessment system. What is the objective?
questions.explanation: Dr. Sidki explains: 'HR skills assessment aims to improve team management practices.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will participate in the assessment.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad must manage an HR conflict with an employee. What is the right attitude?
options: Act in accordance with the Labor Code
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'The Labor Code is the guide for resolving HR conflicts.' Dr. Sidki: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Sidki must write an article on the future of dental HR management. What trend should be highlighted?
options: HR management in service of well-being and performance
questions.explanation: Dr. Sidki explains: 'The future of HR management is based on well-being and team performance.' Dr. Mourad: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad must create an HR quality label for practices. What are the main criteria?
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'The quality of team and management are the fundamental criteria.' Dr. Sidki: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Sidki must give a speech on the importance of HR management. What message should she convey?
options: HR management is a lever for performance
questions.explanation: Dr. Sidki explains: 'HR management is a lever for performance and sustainability for the practice.' Dr. Mourad: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad must create a scholarship for students in dental HR management. What is the objective?
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Encouraging excellence in HR management is an investment for the future.' Dr. Sidki: 'I will support this initiative.'

questions.question: Dr. Sidki must pass on her HR management knowledge. What is the most effective method?
questions.explanation: Dr. Sidki explains: 'Personalized mentoring and practical cases are the most effective methods.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will get involved in mentoring.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad must create a peer network for young dentists in HR management. What is the objective?
options: Foster mutual support and experience sharing
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Mutual support and sharing are essential for young dentists in HR management.' Dr. Sidki: 'I will support this network.'

questions.question: Dr. Sidki must write a conclusion to her book on HR management. What is the final sentence?
options: HR management is an art of management
questions.explanation: Dr. Sidki explains: 'HR management is an art of management in service of performance.' Dr. Mourad: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad must leave a legacy to the profession. What is the most beautiful legacy?
options: HR skills and an example to follow
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'HR skills and the example are the most beautiful legacy one can leave.' Dr. Sidki: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Sidki must train future HR mentors. What is the first message to convey?
options: Mentoring is a mission of support and transmission
Mentoring is a source of income
questions.explanation: Dr. Sidki explains: 'Mentoring is a mission of support and transmission of HR skills.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will convey this message.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad must write a letter to future dentists about HR management. What message should he convey?
options: HR management is a pillar of professional success
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'HR management is a pillar of professional success.' Dr. Sidki: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Sidki must create an award for young dentists in HR management. What is the purpose?
questions.explanation: Dr. Sidki explains: 'Stimulating excellence in HR management is essential for the evolution of the profession.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will support this award.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad, after a career dedicated to HR management, receives national recognition. Dr. Sidki is by his side. What is Dr. Mourad's message to young dentists?
options: HR management is a lever for performance and happiness
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad concludes: 'HR management is a lever for performance and happiness at work.' Dr. Sidki: 'I am proud of you.'
